references.text: The Canaanite king of Arad who lived in the Negev heard that Israel was coming and fighting against them. This is the parallel account that gives more details about the conflict with the king of Arad.
The king of Arad is mentioned among the kings whom Joshua and the Israelites defeated when they entered the land of Canaan.
The Negev region and the area around Arad are mentioned in connection with the Kenites who settled there together with the tribe of Judah.
The Negev is mentioned as part of the land of Canaan that was promised to Abraham's descendants.
The spies reported that the Canaanites lived in the Negev, confirming the geographical location of the king of Arad.
